title: Lawn care & mowing
description: A lawn care site built around the schedule: mowing and treatment plans priced per visit, a line-by-line plan comparison, a proof gallery, testimonials, and a booking form that asks for a frequency, not a project — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

theme.$comment: Deep emerald over the warm-boutique register's cream warmth — the recurring shape's herbal-green cleaner deepened to turf. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-skins the pages and the app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared servicesRecurringShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the base cleaner wears the pill-links cluster, so the lawncare remix takes the inline floating card — the nav-variety audit spreads the nine-template services family across the vocabulary.
